title: CodeChallenge: Laminar profile of autoencoder sparsity

cues.en: Now that you've seen some instruction and code demos on how to create, train and interpret sparse autoencoders

cues.zh: 這次程式挑戰，我們會在研究粒度和深度上退一步，

cues.en: and just focus on the characteristics of the autoencoder results over different layers in a GPT model.

cues.en: Instead, we will explore how the token activation densities change inside the model.
